We evaluate our models in terms of overall translation quality (BLEU) and also employ three types of automatic pronoun‑focused evaluation: Accuracy of Pronoun Translation (APT), Precision/Recall/F1 (AutoPRF), and an ELMo‑based CRC metric.
For evaluation, we compute BLEU on tokenised truecased text and measure statistical significance with p < 0.005.
